evals.prompt: Please create an ARCHITECTURE.md for this Express + Postgres app. I want a durable technical overview of the system.
evals.expected_output: Chooses create mode, performs codebase-first discovery, generates the full architecture template, and asks only targeted follow-up questions for real unknowns.

evals.prompt: Update our ARCHITECTURE.md to reflect the current codebase. We recently added Redis caching and GitHub Actions deploys.
evals.expected_output: Chooses refresh mode, reads the existing file first, performs drift detection, and previews changed sections before writing.

evals.prompt: Our ARCHITECTURE.md is messy and inconsistent. Please clean it up into a better structure without losing content.
evals.expected_output: Detects restructure mode, offers restructure/append/dry-run options, and does not silently rewrite meaningful existing content without explicit user choice.

evals.prompt: Generate a root ARCHITECTURE.md for this monorepo so new engineers can understand all apps, packages, and shared infrastructure.
evals.expected_output: Detects monorepo root scope and produces a repo-wide architecture doc with package-aware component coverage.

evals.prompt: I'm inside packages/web. Create an ARCHITECTURE.md for this package only.
evals.expected_output: Defaults to package-level scope, detects any root ARCHITECTURE.md above, and references the root doc instead of duplicating shared infrastructure.

evals.prompt: Create architecture docs for this package. We're in a monorepo, but I only need this package documented for now.
evals.expected_output: Handles package-level documentation even when no root ARCHITECTURE.md exists, without wrongly expanding to repo-wide scope.

evals.prompt: Create ARCHITECTURE.md and use the project's existing OpenSpec setup if helpful.
evals.expected_output: Detects openspec/config.yml or config.yaml, uses it as stack context, and reduces redundant scanning where appropriate.

evals.prompt: Document the architecture of this repo, but there may not be much deployment config checked in.
evals.expected_output: Does not fabricate infrastructure details, uses TODO markers for unresolved fields, and asks only the missing deployment questions.

evals.prompt: Generate a comprehensive ARCHITECTURE.md for this platform repo with frontend, backend, workers, and infra.
evals.expected_output: Covers all discovery domains, prefers parallel discovery when available, and merges findings into a coherent architecture document.

evals.prompt: Refresh ARCHITECTURE.md. Findings: - We migrated auth from session cookies to JWT. - The worker now consumes from Redis streams instead of BullMQ.
evals.expected_output: Parses the findings list, merges those facts with drift detection, announces both sources, and scopes questions to the remaining unknowns.

evals.prompt: Create an ARCHITECTURE.md for this repo and make sure agent onboarding docs can find it.
evals.expected_output: Creates the architecture doc first, then updates AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md only if the reference is missing and the pointer-file rule is respected.
